summary: The paper describes the use of spatial atomic layer deposition (S-ALD) for depositing zinc oxide (ZnO) thin-film transistors (TFTs). The process utilizes gas isolation and operates at atmospheric pressure, allowing for high deposition rates and good film quality. The study highlights the effectiveness of S-ALD in achieving high mobility and stability in ZnO-based devices, as well as its capability for selective area deposition using inhibitors like PMMA.
